title: The Hole In Your Airplane Window Is Supposed To Be There
hook: The thing you assumed was a defect is load-bearing.

cast.note: Gus is cabin crew — one deadpan look, no dialogue beat of his own.

scenes.note: Window and hole legible at frame 0. No establishing shot — Bill is already nose-to-glass.

beats.action: Bill pressed against the window, face squashed toward the glass; the window and its tiny hole are on screen at frame 0
hard camera punch onto the hole; it pops one size larger and a red circle snaps around it
Bill recoils into shockedBack, horrified; sweat drop
beats.sync: keyword: supposed — the reassurance lands as a threat

beats.action: Bill turns deadpan to camera while the hole stays circled behind him

scenes.note: The mechanism scene. Cutaway diagram, built one pane at a time.

beats.action: camera dollies to a side-on cutaway of the window; Bill shrinks to a small figure at the left
three panes slide in from the right and stack with a click each — outer, middle, inner
the breather hole pops into the INNER pane with a label arrow
the inner pane flashes; the other two dim so the reading is unambiguous

scenes.note: Pressure is shown as arrows with weight, not as a word. The outer pane visibly takes the load.

beats.action: pressure arrows push inward on the outer pane; the gap between panes equalises through the hole
the middle pane flexes a few units and settles; a small equalising puff travels through the breather hole
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: middle pane relaxes visibly — arrows on it shrink to nothing
big arrows thump against the outer pane; it bows a few units and holds
outer pane lights up coral and a STRUCTURAL label stamps onto it
camera pulls back to the plane in cross-section at altitude; tiny clouds slide past

scenes.note: Second job of the same hole. Short scene, one clean visual.

beats.action: fog blooms between the panes and greys the view out
the fog streams out through the breather hole in little curls; the view clears left to right
the last of the fog curls away and the glass squeaks clear; the wing outside sharpens into focus
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Back to the seat. Gus arrives, delivers nothing, leaves. The restraint is the joke.

beats.action: cut back to the cabin; Bill has the call button pressed and a panic face
Gus walks off; Bill lowers his hand slowly
the cleared view opens onto a wing and slow clouds; Bill leans in to look through it
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: Bill lowers the call button and looks at the window with new respect
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: a NOT A DEFECT stamp slams across the window
Gus arrives in the aisle, looks at the window, looks at Bill, says nothing

scenes.note: Reframe: the hole goes from suspect to hero. Hard cut on the last word.

beats.action: the outer pane gets a tiny gold STRUCTURAL badge that Bill does not notice
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the red suspicion circle around the hole pops back on
the circle flips from coral to teal and sparkles; the hole is promoted
Bill gives the window a tiny respectful thumbs up, still slightly afraid of it; hard cut
